# Multi-truck fit study

One camper, sized to the design truck **F350_LONG**, checked against each truck. The camper does not change shape per truck. **Status: CONCEPT.** Truck values other than the 2011 F-350 are published bed dimensions plus estimates (see `truck_data/README.md`); weights and CG are first-pass estimates.

Loaded camper = dry estimate (mean) + jacks + power-zone and roof-rack reservations + 300 lb owner gear. CG is computed from envelope face centroids (`scripts_code/estimates.py`), not the floor midpoint.

## Rules applied

- Camper CG must be **at or ahead of the rear axle** (Ford: CG data on the truck's Consumer Information Sheet; Northern Lite: camper CG must be forward of the bulkhead-to-axle distance). PASS needs >= 2 in margin.
- Loaded camper must not exceed the truck's camper cargo rating. A range means it depends on engine/options: read the door-jamb sticker.
- The tailgate is never structural (hard rule). Overhang means the camper floor cantilevers past the bed end; the tailgate is lowered or removed and must not carry load.
- Lateral clearance >= 0.5 in per side; nose >= 3 in over the cab roof.
